name: WisdomTwin
description: A private prototype for role-scoped business questions and cited source evidence. Slack adapter code is available; production connection is unverified. Gmail and Google Drive remain gated.

slack.availability: Real use requires provisioned corporate identity, matched workspace/user grant and operator-confirmed provider authorization.

gmail.availability: Disabled. Current adapter reads snippets or metadata only; full message ingestion is incomplete.

drive.availability: Disabled. Current adapter reads file names and descriptions only; document body ingestion is incomplete.

tools.name: connect_business_account
tools.description: Bind an authorized business account to an operator-assigned role and return a read-only source authorization URL.

tools.name: ingest_data
tools.description: On user instruction, fetch and embed accessible business evidence into the protected role index.

tools.name: query_twin
tools.description: Retrieve role evidence, re-check current source access and return supported citations.

tools.name: list_twins_status
tools.description: List only the caller's visible role connection status.

auth.mcp: Corporate OIDC sign-in and operator-provisioned role entitlements, followed by MCP authorization-code flow with PKCE S256 and resource validation.
auth.storage: Durable encrypted Postgres OAuth and source credentials in production. SQLite and fixtures are local test adapters.

connectors.slack: Read-only authorization grant bound to verified corporate identity and provisioned Slack workspace/user.
connectors.gmail: Disabled; Google subject binding and verification gates remain required.
connectors.drive: Disabled; Google subject binding and verification gates remain required.
